setup.H_sigma: G[S_sigma], where S_sigma is one fixed B0 coarse source class and therefore every v in S_sigma has the same exact 3-list L_sigma.
setup.auxiliary_step: Run the known polynomial P7-free List-3-Colouring algorithm on H_sigma after relabeling L_sigma to {1,2,3}.
setup.no_case: If no such coloring exists, no global extension of the source branch exists because every global extension restricts to a proper L_sigma-respecting coloring of H_sigma.
setup.yes_case: Let phi_sigma be one returned auxiliary coloring and R_i={v in S_sigma:phi_sigma(v)=i}; each R_i is a stable set.
setup.firewall: phi_sigma is used only to certify stable layers and is not fixed as the coloring of a future global extension.
setup.incidence: I_{sigma,i} is bipartite with left side R_i and right side the connected components of residual G[Y0]; vC is an edge iff v is complete to C.

statement: For every fixed sigma, every i in {1,2,3}, every k>=1, and every induced path Q on k vertices in I_{sigma,i}, replacing each component-node C of Q by an arbitrary representative c_C in C produces an induced path on k vertices in G.

distinctness: An induced path has distinct vertices, so its component-nodes denote distinct connected components of G[Y0].
Choosing one representative from each component-node therefore gives distinct vertices, all distinct from survivor vertices.
proof.consecutive_edges: Every path edge between survivor v and component C means v is complete to C by the definition of I_{sigma,i}; hence v is adjacent in G to the chosen representative c_C.
proof.nonconsecutive_cross_pairs: If survivor v and component C are nonconsecutive in Q, inducedness of Q gives vC nonedge in I_{sigma,i}. B0 component uniformity says v is either complete or anticomplete to C. Since it is not complete, it is anticomplete, so v is nonadjacent in G to c_C.
proof.same_side_survivor_pairs: Every two survivor-nodes of Q lie in R_i, which is stable because phi_sigma is a proper coloring; hence no survivor-survivor chord exists.
proof.same_side_component_pairs: Every two component-nodes of Q are distinct connected components of G[Y0], so no edge of G joins their chosen representatives; hence no component-component chord exists.
proof.exhaustion: Because I_{sigma,i} is bipartite, every pair of vertices in the lifted sequence is either a consecutive cross pair, a nonconsecutive cross pair, a survivor-survivor pair, or a component-component pair. The preceding cases establish exactly the path edges and exclude every chord.
orientation_check: The argument does not depend on whether Q begins/ends on the survivor side or the component side.
In particular it covers both 7-vertex orientations v1-C1-v2-C2-v3-C3-v4 and C1-v1-C2-v2-C3-v3-C4.
proof.conclusion: The lifted sequence is an induced P_k in G.

corollaries.name: P7_FREE_LAYER_COROLLARY
corollaries.derivation: If I_{sigma,i} contained an induced P7, the theorem would lift it to an induced P7 in G, contradicting the ambient P7-free hypothesis.

corollaries.name: EXTERNAL_DECOMPOSITION_IMPORT
corollaries.derivation: Each I_{sigma,i} is bipartite by construction and P7-free by the preceding corollary.
corollaries.conclusion: The existing Lozin-Zamaraev P7-free bipartite chain-decomposition theorem applies to each layer separately.
